_readme: Source allowlist for GritForge Signal Feed. Only sources with tier=official AND status=active can put an item in a paid issue. status=to_confirm means: open the site, find the official agenda/packet/minutes or data page, read the terms and robots.txt, then fill in domains, method, cadence and terms_checked and set status=active. Never add paid bid networks without a license.

tiers.official: Packet, minutes, filing, official release or official API record. Can go in a paid issue.
tiers.lead: Trade press. Use to find the official record. Never a paid source on its own.
tiers.ai_summary: AI-written meeting summaries. Lead only. Item stays Unverified.
tiers.context: Background data (EIA, FRED). Never a job alert on its own.

sources.name: SAM.gov Opportunities API
sources.notes: Collector: scripts/collectors/sam_gov.py (needs SAM_API_KEY). tools/sam_pull.py was never in the kit. Record the date you last read the API terms in terms_checked.

sources.notes: No API. Check robots.txt and site policies before automating; manual check is fine until then.

sources.name: Austin open data (Socrata) permits
sources.notes: Confirm the dataset is current and reuse is allowed. App token optional, later. Column names last checked 2026-03; a rename raises schema_change.
